content.comment_body: Hello, when registering an object in the Amazon cloud, I received the message: 'Unable to connect with AWS IoT'. I tried deleting and creating new users in Amazon, changing IP addresses, and eventually found some updated information about policies that helped. Recently, these policies appeared as selectable options, unlike a few weeks ago, and this seems to have resolved the first connection issue. My primary question is: How can I determine which AWS policies to select when creating a user to ensure proper functionality with [product_name]? My second issue is that, when choosing a brand in [product_name], there is no 'Writable' option, so I can’t control the application from the computer or mobile device. Reinstalling [product_name] reports that it is already up to date. Thank you for your help.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. This is an English-language forum. Please post in English. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered connection issues between a [company_name] device and AWS IoT using [product_name]. Initial problems related to AWS IoT policy configurations were resolved after recent changes. However, the user still cannot configure an object as 'Writable' within [product_name], which restricts remote control capabilities via computer or mobile device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward integration between the [company_name] device and AWS IoT, as well as the ability to easily set device objects to 'Writable' within [product_name] for remote control functionality.
